Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    vals = Counter(v for r in grid for v in r)
    block = vals.most_common(1)[0][0]  # Most common value
    line = [v for v, c in vals.most_common() if v != block][0]  # Second most common
    
    # Find horizontal and vertical lines (rows/cols where ALL values != block)
    hrows = [r for r in range(H) if all(grid[r][c] != block for c in range(W))]
    vcols = [c for c in range(W) if all(grid[r][c] != block for r in range(H))]
    
    # Find marker cells at intersections where value is neither block nor line
    M = {(r, c): grid[r][c] for r in hrows for c in vcols if grid[r][c] not in (block, line)}
    
    mr = sorted({r for r, _ in M})
    mc = sorted({c for _, c in M})
    
    nR, nC = len(mr) - 1, len(mc) - 1
    
    # Create output grid
    out = [[block] * nC for _ in range(nR)]
    
    for i in range(nR):
        for j in range(nC):
            # Get the 4 corners of this region
            corners = [(mr[i], mc[j]), (mr[i], mc[j+1]), (mr[i+1], mc[j]), (mr[i+1], mc[j+1])]
            cv = [M[k] for k in corners if k in M]
            
            # If all 4 corners exist and are the same value, fill that region
            if len(cv) == 4 and len(set(cv)) == 1:
                out[i][j] = cv[0]
    
    return out

# Run the transformation
